_note: The single source of truth for the RL run. launch_rl.py refuses to start without it. This revision points at the RE-ARMED RL targets (v8: venue-conditional entry — AMM {SKIP,WATCH,BUY_FULL} / curve {SKIP,WATCH,BUY_SMALL}, MID retired per KELLY_AUDIT_C12 §b — + 4-arm management from mgmt_c12_aligned), the SCORED forward-wall eval set, and the SFT-013 policy. Everything here is produced by the chain trigger; nothing is filled in by hand.
init_from_note: trainer.save_model(out_dir/final) under FSDP2 writes a CONSOLIDATED BF16 HF dir (verified: the ZeRO-3 gather in consolidate_cpt.py.SUPERSEDED was only needed for CPT's nvme-offloaded checkpoints). launch_rl.py verifies weights exist and hashes the dir.

data.eval_note: The forward wall is the RL eval set and is NEVER trained on. Built in two stages so a wall row is rendered by the SAME annotation path as training and scored by the SAME build_records path: build_sft_c6.py --wall-eval-out (annotated prompts, c6 format, c6 proved byte-identical) -> score_wall_eval.py (counterfactual groups). VERIFIED wall-only: leak_refused=0.

reference.note: Built by grpo_ref_cache.py --action-dist from init_from over the RL train prompts. The cache key is prompt_sha256 and MUST equal the RL dataset key (grpo_ref_cache.py --verify-prompt-hash proves it on a real record).

loop.kl_note: KL is over the 3-action distribution (BUY/WATCH/SKIP) against the cached reference distribution. Token-level KL is NOT computable at rollout time because the cached reference logprobs belong to the SFT completion, not the sampled one.

optim.lr_note: RL LR << SFT LR (2e-6): the policy is already good.
optim.optim_note: 8-bit AdamW is the proven path on this box; full fp32 state does not fit. train_qwen27b.py asserts no fp32 master set - keep that assert.

gate.gate_note: CHECKPOINT SELECTION ONLY. Never select on training reward. The lower 95% bound of net return per episode on the wall must exceed the floor. Selection input is wall episodes only (grpo_loop.run_gate records training_reward_used_for_selection=false).

selection.selection_note: CHECKPOINT SELECTION NEEDS TWO SIGNALS: the wall lower bound (gate) AND a clean memorization verdict from the preregistered instrument (reports/MEMORIZATION_BOUNDS.json, which names this producer). With emit_memorization_records=true the loop re-emits the records FROM THE CANDIDATE POLICY ITSELF at every checkpoint, immediately before the verdict, and reads the file back to refuse a verdict that names a different checkpoint - a stale file can never authorise a selection. FAIL-CLOSED: emission failure is a refusal, never a pass.
selection.mem_limit_note: mem_limit = rows PER GROUP of matched in-sample/unseen prompts the emitter scores (the detector's own floor is 30/group, which is a REFUSAL floor, not a power requirement). 400 was chosen by MEASUREMENT (reports/MEM_LIMIT_POWER_STUDY.json): at 400/group the permutation bound on total-variation choice distance is ~0.095 at alpha=0.01, and a SUBTLE exposure effect (TV 0.10 with a 60 bp outcome gap) was flagged 8/8 seeds - at the 30-row floor the same effect was caught only 5/8. Cost: 400x2 = 800 prompts x group_size(4) = 3,200 generations per checkpoint, i.e. ~7% of the ONE wall eval (10,802 prompts x 4 = 43,208 generations) the loop already runs at every save.
selection.mem_limit_floor_rule: A shortfall against mem_limit is REPORTED in the report json (limit_shortfall), never silently absorbed and never fatal; below the prereg's 30/group the producer REFUSES.

checkpoint.resume_note: Resume, never restart: the loop reloads optimizer+step from the newest checkpoint and skips completed prompts by prompt_sha256.

on_chain_inputs.amm_venue_fee: INSIDE the pool price - gross/net ratio p50 = 1.0 over 88,918 fills; adding it again would double-charge

cost_calibration.engine_floor_source: exit_mechanics.cost_floor_bps(notional_sol=1.0), the notional the RL engine actually trades (grpo_dataset: V3Engine(deploy_sol=1.0))
cost_calibration.note: DERIVED, not inherited. Reconciliation is exact: the 210 bp prior is an ALL-IN execution prior, and at the engine's real 1.0 SOL deploy size the bonding-curve floor is 189-209 bp - so the prior sits at or above every fee quantile. The AMM floor is far lower (0-20 bp) because the AMM venue fee lives INSIDE the reserve price and is deliberately not charged twice. Size matters: the fixed tx fee is a lamport amount, so in bp it scales as 1/notional (p99 = 10.05 bp/leg at 1.0 SOL but 100.5 at 0.1 SOL). CHARGE p50 in training (189 bp curve / 0 bp AMM) and evaluate the gate at p99 (209 / 20) so a policy is never promoted on optimistic costs. WATCH: grpo_dataset deploys 1.0 SOL while reward_engine/economic_exam use 0.5 - always compute the floor at the notional the engine actually trades.
